name: Portal — BYOM models visible in playground
summary: BYOM-routed models do not appear in the Foundry portal's Models + endpoints page or the Chat / Agents Playground model picker.
description: The Foundry portal playground model picker is the UI surface that lists deployments users can select for chat or agent playground runs. BYOM connections of type `ApiManagement` or `ModelGateway` work from code as `{connection}/{deployment}`, but the user problem is whether those gateway deployments are discoverable for point-and-click testing.
notes:
Not yet probed with an automated portal check. Docs for AI Gateway setup: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway.

Current observation: `ApiManagement` and `ModelGateway` connections register and work from SDK / Responses API calls, but their deployments do not appear in the portal playground model dropdowns. This is adjacent to `portal-ui-parity-providers` but covers runtime model selection rather than connection creation.
